title: FBI Photo B14
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp in the image is incorrect and the image contains redactions.

incidents.summary: Two small, dark, circular objects observed in a grainy, monochrome surveillance image.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: Two small, dark, circular objects are visible near the center of the frame.
